intents.name: fan-out
intents.notes: the new session does not see this conversation, so PROMPT says everything the task needs
intents.when: a task should run in its own pane, one agent session per task

intents.name: run-beside
intents.notes: then read FILE; it prints opened ID, and running it again with the same --key prints reused ID instead of opening a second pane; tiili close ID closes it
intents.recipe: tiili open --key dev -- sh -c 'CMD 2>&1 | tee FILE'
intents.when: a long-running command (a dev server, a watcher, tests) should run beside you while you read its output

intents.name: need-you
intents.notes: marks your own pane with MSG while the user is elsewhere; it clears when they focus the pane, or with tiili attention --clear
intents.when: you need the user: a question, a finished task, something to review

intents.name: find-reuse
intents.notes: each pane in panes has id, cwd, title, running.command, tab, key, self and opened_by_you; tiili close works only on panes with opened_by_you true
intents.when: you want to find a pane to reuse, read or close
